mainEntity.name: When do I need to hire a rear-end collision lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider hiring a rear-end collision lawyer if you sustained injuries, if there's a dispute over fault, or if the insurance company offers a settlement that doesn't cover your medical bills and lost wages. A lawyer can help navigate the complexities of personal injury law, negotiate with insurance companies, and ensure you receive fair compensation for damages. It's often beneficial to consult a lawyer early to understand your legal options and avoid common pitfalls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a lawyer if you're injured, there's fault dispute, or the insurance settlement is inadequate. They can help navigate legal complexities and secure fair compensation.
